meta.bt_team: Team rows tested on every game 2019 to 2026, each judged only on games before it: teams 8-2+ ATS in their last 10 went 83-104 (-14.7%); 15-5+ in their last 20 45-35 (+7.1%); 70%+ in today's role 45-55 (-14.1%); 2-8 or worse 77-90 (-11.8%) the next game at closing prices. Team ATS streaks are noise against the closing line.
meta.bt: Tested out of sample (2021 to 2026, each season judged only on trends from the seasons before it): every side with a spot covering 5+ points above what its closing price implied (55%+ at -110) on 50+ games went 493-494 (50.0%, -4.7% return) against the closing line; 8+ points (58%+) on 100+ games, 136-124 (52.3%, +0.1% return); the first line alone, 293-267 (52.3%, +0.0% return). Totals the same way: 245-228 (51.8%, -1.2% return). Graded at each game's closing price: mixed, near break-even and mostly inside normal luck. Context, not a pick.
meta.bt_short: League row out of sample (2021 to 2026, each season judged on the two seasons before it): sides whose spot ran 55%+ (5+ points over the price) on 50+ games went 293-267 (52.3%, +0.0% return), about break-even, inside normal luck.
meta.bt_held: None of the 34 spots the rule bet made money in 3+ later seasons with p < .05.
